name: Fetch
description: Lets your AI read a web page as clean text - fetched on your computer, converted to markdown, read in pieces so long pages fit. Ask about an article, some docs, or a price page by pasting the link. Much lighter than a full browser when nothing needs clicking.

mcp.also: Use fetch to read a page before answering questions about it, and prefer the person's exact link over guessing one. Long pages come in pieces - fetch again with start_index until you have what you need. Say plainly when a page would not loa
